news.headline: Four quarterbacks still fighting for the job
news.summary: Zeon Chriss-Gremillion ran for two touchdowns in the first fall scrimmage and the offense gave the ball away only once. Coach Will Hall names his first depth chart on August 24.

news.headline: Defense dominates in first fall scrimmage
news.summary: Tulane's defense set the tone early in Saturday's first scrimmage, and coach Will Hall said the offense answered back in the red zone. The four-way quarterback race stays open with the season opener three weeks away.

news.headline: Florida left out of preseason AP Top 25
news.summary: The Gators didn't crack the AP's preseason poll, though they had the second-most votes among unranked teams. It's a fresh-start season under new coach Jon Sumrall, so this is the low point expectations can only rise from.

news.headline: QB battle still even after first scrimmage
news.summary: Neither Aaron Philo nor Tramell Jones Jr. has separated himself in fall camp, coach Jon Sumrall said after Florida's first scrimmage. The competition is expected to continue right up until the season opener.

news.headline: Sumrall gives injury update after scrimmage
news.summary: Receiver Vernell Brown III and defensive back Dijon Johnson, who both sat out the scrimmage as a precaution, were back at full practice Monday. Defensive back Jordy Lowery was the only player actually hurt, with a minor soft-tissue injury.

news.headline: Four Longhorns named to preseason All-America team
news.summary: Trevor Goosby, Cam Coleman, Colin Simmons, and Rasheem Biles all made the AP's preseason All-America team, more than any other program in the country. It's a strong vote of confidence heading into the season.

news.headline: Left tackle Goosby has bone bruise in knee
news.summary: Star left tackle Trevor Goosby was diagnosed with a bone bruise in his left knee after a non-contact injury at Monday's practice. He avoided a torn ligament, but his timeline for returning is still unclear.

news.headline: Alvin Kamara out at least a month with knee sprain
news.summary: Kamara sprained the MCL in his knee during Tuesday's joint practice with the Cowboys and is expected to miss at least a month. It's a tough blow to the Saints' offense heading into the season.

news.headline: Saints, Cowboys scuffle in joint practice
news.summary: Tuesday's joint practice with the Cowboys in Oxnard got chippy, with several scuffles breaking out. Coach Kellen Moore said the team still got the work it needed done.

news.headline: Rookie receiver Jordyn Tyson out 8 weeks
news.summary: First-round pick Jordyn Tyson strained his hamstring and is expected to miss about eight weeks. Coach Kellen Moore says this injury is not related to his past hamstring problems.

news.headline: Stanton nearing return from calf injury
news.summary: Manager Aaron Boone said Giancarlo Stanton is near the end of his running program and responding well. There is still no firm timeline for his return.

news.headline: Yankees edge Orioles in third straight win
news.summary: New York beat Baltimore 5-3 on Wednesday, helped by a controversial call that went the Yankees' way and a home run from Ben Rice. It was the Yankees' third win over the Orioles in a row.

news.headline: Carlos Rodón returns with 4 solid innings
news.summary: Rodón made his first start since early July and pitched four innings against Baltimore. Trent Grisham's home run carried the Yankees to a 3-1 win.
